{{Quote|General, what happened to your face? Or is that patch just something you wear to impress the natives?''"<br />"''I lost my eye in our final battle against one of the many would-be warlords out here.|Mara Jade and Baron Soontir Fel|<ref name="VTF" />}}
A final '''battle''' between the [[Empire of the Hand]]<ref name="VTF" /> confederation<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> and a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] took place. During the battle, Imperial [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] lost [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]], which prompted him to retire.<ref name="VTF" /> In 19 ABY,<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Vision of the Future]]'' take place in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Fel, who was wearing an eye patch, recounted his loss at the battle to former [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] after she [[Mission to Nirauan|infiltrated]] the Empire of the Hand [[Hand of Thrawn]] complex on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]].<ref name="VTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', the final installment of [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="VTF" />
